summary: Use an Android-compatible exclusive copy for OpenClaw transcript archive publication and stop escalating non-critical proactive ADB readiness into blocking incidents.
reason: Termux app-private storage rejects the OpenClaw hard-link publish with EACCES, and proactive ADB readiness created human_required incidents despite canonical ADB remaining healthy.

tests.name: openclaw-archive-copy
tests.evidence: Synthetic compatibility patch and COPYFILE_EXCL/fsync contract passed.

tests.name: adb-readiness-watchdog
tests.evidence: Closed-loop watchdog test passed: automatic repair still works, proactive degraded readiness emits advisory without incident, and a historical readiness incident still closes on verified readiness.

tests.name: final-runtime-regression
tests.evidence: Archive compatibility test, ADB readiness watchdog, health verdict 11/11, Tier-0 13/13 and incident runtime hardening passed.

capabilities.reason: Existing Android runtime compatibility and readiness escalation semantics are corrected without changing ownership or entrypoints.

architecture.reason: Reuses the existing OpenClaw compatibility patcher and ADB watchdog; no new owner or control plane.

rollback: Revert this commit and promote the previous immutable Tier-0 Last Known Good release.
limitations: Wireless Debugging readiness can remain advisory degraded while Android refuses to enable it; current canonical ADB remains independently verified.
No payment or user Android application code is modified.
